localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
G1 has four Adirondack (three-sided) shelters, each sleep eight people. The camp offers a covered cooking and meeting area, a group fire ring, room for 32 people in tents and two vault toilets. Restrooms are approximately a half mile away. Due to a small, unlevel parking area, RVs are not allowed. The parking lot is 100 feet from the group camp.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.description:
Please contact Battle Ground Lake State Park at (360) 687-4621 to make a reservation.
This site is an individual equestrian campsite with four horse stalls.

localizedValues.name: S1-Eagle Shelter
localizedValues.description:
One kitchen shelter with electricity. Arrive early as parking is limited, carpooling is recommended. During the winter months, water may be turned off, and the nearest accessible restroom may be located down by the beach.
